compute_dice_loss: compute the DICE loss between predicted masks and ground truth target masks for segmentation
compute_sigmoid_ce_loss: compute the sigmoid cross entropy loss between predicted logits and binary target masks
calculate_uncertainty: calculate uncertainty scores from logit predictions using L1 distance from zero for point sampling
create_set_criterion: create a SetCriterion module to compute Hungarian assignment and loss for MaskFormer segmentation models
run_set_criterion_forward: run the SetCriterion forward pass to compute classification and mask losses against ground truth targets
